news.title: What SBA’s New Size Standards Could Mean for Small Businesses
news.summary_en: The Small Business Administration has announced changes to its standards of what constitute a “small business,” allowing larger firms to access contracts, lending, and other opportunities reserved for small businesses. This Critical Questions analysis explores the new changes’ impact on competition, innovation, and existing small businesses in the federal contracting marketplace.
